question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

Someone who knows a lot about the arts, food, drink, or some other subject
solution:
The correct answer is: **Connoisseur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **connoisseur **is someone who has expert knowledge or refined taste in a particular area, such as the arts, food, drink, or any other subject. (रंग-रूप, खान-पान, पेय, या किसी अन्य विषय में विशेषज्ञ ज्ञान या अद्यतन रूचि वाला व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **For example-** *She is a connoisseur of fine wines and can identify even the subtlest notes and flavours.*
 
 
 
• Hence, it is clear that '**Connoisseur**' can substitute the given group of words.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other words.

__
 
• **Pacifist**: A pacifist is someone who believes in peace and opposes war or violence. (कोई व्यक्ति जो शांति में विश्वास रखता हो और युद्ध या हिंसा का विरोध करता हो)
 
• **Gourmand**: A gourmand is a person who enjoys and appreciates good food, often to the point of excessive indulgence. (एक व्यक्ति जो अच्छे भोजन का आनंद लेता है और उसकी सराहना करता है, अक्सर अत्यधिक भोग की हद तक)
 
• **Cynic**: A cynic is a person who tends to have a negative or skeptical view of things and believes that people are motivated by self-interest. (एक व्यक्ति जो चीजों के प्रति नकारात्मक या संदेहपूर्ण दृष्टिकोण रखता है और मानता है कि लोग स्वार्थ से प्रेरित हैं)
